summary: Russia launched one of its largest combined attacks, firing approximately 80 cruise missiles, up to 20 ballistic missiles, and around 400 drones targeting energy infrastructure, bridges, and enterprises across Ukraine, with strikes reported in Kyiv, Lviv, and western regions. Ukrainian air defenses claimed 94% interception of cruise missiles and 83% of Shahed drones, while Ukrainian forces struck three Russian ballistic missile launchers and attacked the Dorogobuzh explosives plant in Russia. Two Russian Kh-101 missiles and a Shahed drone violated Polish airspace, prompting an investigation.
key_points: Russia launched ~80 cruise missiles, ~20 ballistic missiles, and ~400 drones in massive overnight attack targeting energy, bridges, and enterprises. (Source: @UkraineNow/85427)
Ukrainian air defenses shot down 94% of cruise missiles and 83% of Shahed drones during the attack. (Source: @UkraineNow/85427)
Russian strikes hit Lviv's Sknylyv railway station, killing two and injuring at least four civilians. (Source: @eRadarrua/132276)
Ukrainian forces destroyed one Russian ballistic missile launcher and damaged two others, per Zelenskyy. (Source: @UkraineNow/85429)
Two Russian Kh-101 missiles and a Shahed drone fell in Poland, violating its airspace during the attack. (Source: @UkraineNow/85428)
UK and Norway announced £100 million funding for two strike boats for Ukrainian Navy to protect Black Sea corridors. (Source: @DeepStateUA/24014)
EU disbursed nearly €8 billion to Ukraine under Ukraine Facility, largest single tranche to date. (Source: @UkraineNow/85431)
Ukrainian drones struck the Dorogobuzh plant in Smolensk region, which produces explosives components for Russian army. (Source: @UkraineNow/85418)

points: Ukraine received nearly €8 billion from the EU under the Ukraine Facility, the largest single tranche in the program's history, with funds already deposited into the state budget to ensure financial stability and cover priority wartime needs. (Source: @UkraineNow/85431)

Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 94% of Russian cruise missiles and 83% of Shahed-type drones during the massive overnight attack, according to Air Force spokesman Yuriy Ihnat, who described it as one of the most powerful attacks to date. (Source: @UkraineNow/85427)

Ukrainian forces struck three Russian ballistic missile launchers, destroying one and damaging two others, as confirmed by President Zelenskyy, who noted the attack featured multiple missile groups with 20-30 minute pauses. (Source: @UkraineNow/85429)

Ukrainian drones attacked the Dorogobuzh chemical plant in Russia's Smolensk region, 290 km from the Ukrainian border, which produces ammonia, nitric acid, and ammonium nitrate used for manufacturing explosives for the Russian army. (Source: @UkraineNow/85418)

The UK and Norway pledged over £100 million to build two strike boats for the Ukrainian Navy, to be constructed in the UK with European equipment, funded equally through the maritime coalition led by London and Oslo to strengthen Black Sea coastal defense and trade routes. (Source: @DeepStateUA/24014)

Russia launched approximately 80 Kh-101 cruise missiles, up to 20 ballistic missiles, and around 400 Shahed drones in a massive coordinated strike targeting energy infrastructure, bridges, and enterprises across Ukraine, with special attention to Kyiv and western regions. (Source: @UkraineNow/85427)

Russian strategic aviation relocated roughly seven Tu-95MS bombers from the Ukrainka airfield to Engels and Olenya airfields, with some already airborne, indicating preparation for sustained cruise missile campaigns. (Source: @UkraineNow/85416)

Russian missiles struck the civilian railway infrastructure in Lviv, hitting the ticket terminal at Sknylyv station directly, killing two people and injuring at least four on the station territory. (Source: @eRadarrua/132276)

Russian reactive UAVs were launched from multiple directions including Bryansk region (RF), Kursk region (Orel), Black Sea, and occupied southern Ukrainian regions, demonstrating diversified launch platforms. (Source: @kpszsu/97750, @eRadarrua/132313, @kpszsu/97740)

Putin was reportedly furious at Zelenskyy over the Crimean Bridge strike, according to Trump, who stated Putin is "tired of war" and wants peace, while Trump pressured European leaders to negotiate with the Kremlin. (Source: @UkraineNow/85409, @UkraineNow/85422)
A reactive UAV from Zaporizhzhia region headed toward Dnipropetrovsk region on course to Kryvyi Rih, indicating continued drone pressure on central-eastern Ukraine. (Source: @kpszsu/97732)
A reactive UAV targeted Zaporizhzhia region from the south, while a group of reactive UAVs from the Black Sea approached southern Odesa region toward Lebedivka. (Source: @kpszsu/97730, @kpszsu/97740)
Dnipropetrovsk region reported one group of strike UAVs and one group of reactive UAVs active in its airspace. (Source: @eRadarrua/132324)

A reactive UAV from Kherson region moved toward Mykolaiv region on course to Bashtanka, and another from Mykolaiv region headed to Odesa region toward Berezivka. (Source: @kpszsu/97756, @kpszsu/97759)

Reactive UAVs in northern Chernihiv region moved toward Ripky, Chernihiv, and Kholmy, while a group of reactive UAVs from Bryansk region (RF) entered Chernihiv region. (Source: @kpszsu/97728, @kpszsu/97750)

A reactive UAV from Chernihiv region headed toward northern Kyiv region on course to Chornobyl, and three Kh-101 cruise missiles from Chernihiv region flew toward Kyiv region's Vyshhorod district. (Source: @kpszsu/97758, @mon1tor_ua/78670)
Reactive UAVs from Sumy region moved toward Chernihiv region past Parafiivka, and a reactive UAV was reported on Kharkiv region toward Slobozhanske. (Source: @eRadarrua/132328)
Chernihiv region hosted two groups of reactive UAVs, Zhytomyr region had one group of strike UAVs, and Kyiv region had one group of reactive UAVs per monitoring data. (Source: @eRadarrua/132330)
A group of reactive UAVs from the Black Sea approached southern Odesa region on course to Lebedivka. (Source: @kpszsu/97740)
A reactive UAV from Kherson region moved toward Mykolaiv region heading to Bashtanka. (Source: @kpszsu/97756)
A reactive UAV from Mykolaiv region headed to Odesa region on course to Berezivka. (Source: @kpszsu/97759)
A reactive UAV was reported on Kirovohrad region moving toward Pomiichna. (Source: @eRadarrua/132328)
